jordan: Hi team, quick one  my kid turned 26 on 2026-03-15 and HR flagged them as ineligible. They were a part-time grad student and still on our plan. Is there any wiggle room or an appeal?

claire (Benefits): Hi Jordan  federal rules usually cap dependent coverage at 26 for medical; some carriers allow student status exceptions but most changed to the 26 cap after ACA updates. Was your child enrolled as a student-dependent under any special provision?

jordan: When we added them they were full-time undergrad, then switched to part-time masters in 2026-02. I thought the carrier allowed student status through the semester. The school confirms part-time but still enrolled.

ryan (People Ops): Carrier policies differ. If the plan relied on full-time student status, part-time can make them ineligible. We can file an exception request if you have documentation showing continuous enrollment and any carrier-specific waiver. Upload transcript/enrollment letter in HiBob and we'll submit to the carrier for review.

jordan: Ok uploading the enrollment letter now. Any chance of COBRA for them?

claire (Benefits): COBRA is generally available for dependents who lose coverage due to aging out. If they're ineligible, they should receive a COBRA notice from the carrier or third-party admin. We'll trigger the COBRA packet when the termination is processed. Note: COBRA premiums are typically higher (employee pays full premium + admin).

jordan: If carrier grants a short extension until end of semester, will payroll adjust premiums retro? Don't want a surprise deduction.

payroll-bot: Automated: Retro premium adjustments require Benefits confirmation and timing relative to payroll cutoffs (1-15, 16-end). Retro can be prorated over up to 2 pay periods on request.

ryan (People Ops): If the carrier approves extension back to 3/01, we can request retro deductions be spread. Put "split retro" in your HiBob note so Payroll sees it.

jordan: Uploaded enrollment letter + advisor note that class load is part-time but program considers them matriculated. Tagged "appeal" and asked to split retro.

people-ops-bot: Automated: Appeal request submitted by jordan  status: pending carrier review. Ref: APPEAL-20260315-7702

claire (Benefits): Received docs. We'll submit to the carrier and follow up in 3 business days. If carrier denies, we'll send COBRA packet; if approved we'll update coverage and coordinate retro premiums.
